events.text: Audited active first-party Zig: found 463 @intFromFloat callsites in 87 files. Mechanical semantic-preserving replacement is complete; direct typed floor/ceil/round/trunc and exact small-int coercion cleanup is in progress, with a gate and compiler-contract test being added.

resolution: Adopted the Zig 0.16 expression dialect across active first-party code: removed all 464 deprecated @intFromFloat calls, collapsed direct integer rounding forms, removed 425 @floatFromInt wrappers only where the full integer type is exactly representable, retained precision- and clamp-sensitive conversions, documented the inference rules, and added a compiler-contract test plus an enforcement gate. The editor, binaries, tests, and lane-0 gates are green.
